title: Learning transferable visual models from natural language supervision
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)
one_line_finding: Contrastive pretraining on 400M image-text pairs yields an image encoder whose text-prompted zero-shot classification rivals supervised baselines across 30+ benchmarks.

title: Scaling up visual and vision-language representation learning with noisy text supervision
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)
one_line_finding: Shows that a simple dual-encoder trained on over one billion noisy alt-text pairs compensates for label noise through scale.

title: An image is worth 16x16 words: Transformers for image recognition at scale
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: Treats an image as a sequence of patch tokens processed by a plain Transformer, which matches CNNs when pretrained at scale; the patch-token grid underlies dense CLIP features.

title: Sigmoid loss for language image pre-training
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)
one_line_finding: Replaces the softmax contrastive loss with a pairwise sigmoid loss, decoupling batch size from normalisation and improving efficiency of image-text pretraining.

title: Reproducible scaling laws for contrastive language-image learning
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
one_line_finding: Open reproduction of CLIP training on LAION shows power-law scaling of zero-shot and transfer performance with data, model and compute.

title: EVA: Exploring the limits of masked visual representation learning at scale
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
one_line_finding: Masked reconstruction of CLIP features scales a ViT to one billion parameters and provides strong initialisation for later EVA-CLIP models.

title: Visual instruction tuning
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Connects a CLIP visual encoder to a large language model and tunes it on machine-generated instruction data, producing a general multimodal assistant.

title: Learning to prompt for vision-language models
venue: International Journal of Computer Vision
one_line_finding: Learns continuous context vectors in place of hand-crafted prompts, giving large few-shot gains for CLIP but weaker generalisation to unseen classes.

title: Conditional prompt learning for vision-language models
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
one_line_finding: Conditions learned prompts on each image through a lightweight meta-network, recovering generalisation to novel classes lost by static prompts.

title: CLIP-Adapter: Better vision-language models with feature adapters
venue: International Journal of Computer Vision
one_line_finding: Adds residual bottleneck adapters on frozen CLIP features, blending adapted and zero-shot knowledge for few-shot transfer.

title: Tip-Adapter: Training-free adaption of CLIP for few-shot classification
venue: Computer Vision - ECCV 2022, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, Springer
one_line_finding: Builds a key-value cache from few-shot image features so CLIP can be adapted without training, with optional brief fine-tuning of the cache.

title: MaPLe: Multi-modal prompt learning
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
one_line_finding: Couples learnable prompts in both vision and language branches across depth, improving base-to-novel generalisation of CLIP.

title: Robust fine-tuning of zero-shot models
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
one_line_finding: Weight-space interpolation between zero-shot and fine-tuned CLIP retains distribution-shift robustness while gaining in-distribution accuracy.

title: Visual classification via description from large language models
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: Scores classes by CLIP similarity to LLM-generated descriptive attributes, improving accuracy and giving per-descriptor explanations.

title: What does a platypus look like? Generating customized prompts for zero-shot image classification
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)
one_line_finding: Uses LLM-generated, category-specific sentences as prompt ensembles, raising CLIP zero-shot accuracy without extra training.

title: Language in a bottle: Language model guided concept bottlenecks for interpretable image classification
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
one_line_finding: Selects discriminative LLM-proposed concepts and trains a linear bottleneck on CLIP concept scores, reaching black-box accuracy with interpretability.

title: Label-free concept bottleneck models
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: Converts any backbone into a concept bottleneck model using LLM-derived concepts and CLIP-based alignment, without concept annotations.

title: Extract free dense labels from CLIP
venue: Computer Vision - ECCV 2022, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, Springer
one_line_finding: Shows that the value-embedding path of the final CLIP attention layer yields spatially meaningful patch features enabling annotation-free segmentation.

title: SCLIP: Rethinking self-attention for dense vision-language inference
venue: Computer Vision - ECCV 2024, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, Springer
one_line_finding: Attributes CLIP's poor dense prediction to spatial misalignment in self-attention and fixes it training-free with correlative self-attention.

title: ClearCLIP: Decomposing CLIP representations for dense vision-language inference
venue: Computer Vision - ECCV 2024, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, Springer
one_line_finding: Identifies the residual connection and feed-forward block as noise sources in CLIP patch tokens; removing them and using self-self attention sharpens dense maps.

title: A closer look at the explainability of contrastive language-image pre-training
venue: Pattern Recognition
one_line_finding: Diagnoses opposite visualisation and noisy activations in CLIP and proposes architecture and feature surgery for cleaner explanation maps.

title: Grad-CAM: Visual explanations from deep networks via gradient-based localization
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)
one_line_finding: Weights final convolutional feature maps by class-gradient averages to produce class-discriminative localisation heatmaps.

title: Quantifying attention flow in Transformers
venue: Proceedings of the 58th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL)
one_line_finding: Introduces attention rollout and attention flow, which propagate attention across layers to better approximate token relevance than raw attention.

title: Toward open set recognition
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
one_line_finding: Formalises open-set recognition with the notion of open-space risk and proposes a 1-vs-set machine to bound it.

title: Towards open set deep networks
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
one_line_finding: OpenMax recalibrates penultimate activations with per-class extreme-value models to estimate an explicit unknown-class probability.

title: A baseline for detecting misclassified and out-of-distribution examples in neural networks
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: Maximum softmax probability serves as a simple yet strong baseline for flagging misclassified and out-of-distribution inputs.

title: Enhancing the reliability of out-of-distribution image detection in neural networks
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: ODIN combines temperature scaling with small input perturbations to widen the softmax score gap between in- and out-of-distribution images.

title: A simple unified framework for detecting out-of-distribution samples and adversarial attacks
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Fits class-conditional Gaussians with shared covariance on deep features and scores inputs by Mahalanobis distance.

title: Energy-based out-of-distribution detection
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Uses the log-sum-exp of logits (free energy) as an OOD score that is better aligned with input density than softmax confidence.

title: Scaling out-of-distribution detection for real-world settings
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)
one_line_finding: At large label spaces the maximum unnormalised logit outperforms softmax-based detectors; introduces large-scale OOD benchmarks.

title: Out-of-distribution detection with deep nearest neighbors
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)
one_line_finding: Non-parametric k-th nearest-neighbour distance on normalised features detects OOD inputs without distributional assumptions.

title: Delving into out-of-distribution detection with vision-language representations
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Maximum concept matching scores inputs by temperature-scaled softmax over CLIP image-text similarities, enabling zero-shot OOD detection.

title: Open-set recognition: A good closed-set classifier is all you need
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: Shows open-set performance correlates strongly with closed-set accuracy and that a well-trained classifier with max-logit scoring matches specialised methods.

title: Generalized out-of-distribution detection: A survey
venue: International Journal of Computer Vision
one_line_finding: Unifies anomaly, novelty, open-set and OOD detection under one framework and reviews methods and benchmarks.

title: Algorithmic Learning in a Random World, 2nd ed.
venue: Springer, Cham
one_line_finding: Foundational treatment of conformal prediction, including inductive and Mondrian (category-conditional) conformal predictors with finite-sample validity.

title: Conditional validity of inductive conformal predictors
venue: Machine Learning
one_line_finding: Analyses training-conditional and object-conditional validity and shows how Mondrian partitions give per-category coverage guarantees.

title: Conformal prediction: A gentle introduction
venue: Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning
one_line_finding: Tutorial on split conformal prediction, score design, conditional coverage diagnostics and extensions such as risk control and shift.

title: Classification with valid and adaptive coverage
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Adaptive prediction sets accumulate sorted class probabilities with randomisation to achieve marginal coverage and improved conditional behaviour.

title: Uncertainty sets for image classifiers using conformal prediction
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: RAPS regularises APS by penalising low-ranked classes, giving much smaller prediction sets on ImageNet with guaranteed coverage.

title: Distribution-free predictive inference for regression
venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
one_line_finding: Establishes split conformal inference with finite-sample marginal coverage under exchangeability only, and studies efficiency and conditional properties.

title: Conformal prediction under covariate shift
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Weighted conformal prediction reweights calibration scores by the likelihood ratio to retain coverage under known covariate shift.

title: Conformal prediction beyond exchangeability
venue: The Annals of Statistics
one_line_finding: Bounds the coverage gap of weighted conformal methods by total-variation terms when exchangeability fails.

title: Adaptive conformal inference under distribution shift
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Online update of the miscoverage level yields long-run coverage guarantees under arbitrary distribution drift.

title: Class-conditional conformal prediction with many classes
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Clustered conformal prediction pools rare classes with similar score distributions to approximate class-conditional coverage when per-class data are scarce.

title: Testing for outliers with conformal p-values
venue: The Annals of Statistics
one_line_finding: Shows conformal p-values are positively dependent, enabling FDR-controlled outlier detection, and proposes calibration-conditional guarantees.

title: Conformal risk control
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: Generalises conformal prediction to bound the expectation of any monotone loss, such as false-negative rate, with finite-sample guarantees.

title: On calibration of modern neural networks
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)
one_line_finding: Modern deep networks are overconfident; single-parameter temperature scaling largely corrects miscalibration.

title: Obtaining well calibrated probabilities using Bayesian binning
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_line_finding: Proposes Bayesian binning into quantiles and popularises expected and maximum calibration error as evaluation measures.

title: Revisiting the calibration of modern neural networks
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Non-convolutional models such as ViT and CLIP-style models are among the best calibrated and their calibration degrades gracefully under shift.

title: Selective classification for deep neural networks
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Constructs a confidence-threshold rejection rule that guarantees a desired risk with high probability, trading coverage for accuracy.

title: Simple and scalable predictive uncertainty estimation using deep ensembles
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Independently trained network ensembles give well-calibrated uncertainty and higher uncertainty on unfamiliar inputs.

title: Dropout as a Bayesian approximation: Representing model uncertainty in deep learning
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)
one_line_finding: Interprets test-time dropout as approximate variational inference, providing Monte Carlo estimates of predictive uncertainty.

title: Evidential deep learning to quantify classification uncertainty
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Places a Dirichlet over class probabilities parameterised by network evidence, yielding a single-pass uncertainty estimate.

title: Can you trust your model's uncertainty? Evaluating predictive uncertainty under dataset shift
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Large benchmark showing calibration of most uncertainty methods deteriorates as shift intensifies, with ensembles most robust.

title: Benchmarking neural network robustness to common corruptions and perturbations
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: Introduces ImageNet-C/P with 15 corruption types at five severities and mean corruption error for robustness evaluation.

title: WILDS: A benchmark of in-the-wild distribution shifts
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)
one_line_finding: Curates real-world domain and subpopulation shift datasets, revealing large in- to out-of-distribution performance gaps.

title: Data determines distributional robustness in contrastive language image pre-training (CLIP)
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)
one_line_finding: Attributes CLIP's effective robustness primarily to training-data diversity rather than language supervision or contrastive loss.

title: Domain generalization: A survey
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
one_line_finding: Reviews domain generalisation problem settings, data augmentation, representation learning and meta-learning approaches with benchmarks.

title: Rank consistent ordinal regression for neural networks with application to age estimation
venue: Pattern Recognition Letters
one_line_finding: CORAL shares weights across binary threshold tasks so that ordinal predictions are rank-consistent.

title: A tutorial on hidden Markov models and selected applications in speech recognition
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE
one_line_finding: Standard reference for HMM evaluation, decoding and Baum-Welch estimation of latent state-transition processes.

title: Multi-state models for panel data: The msm package for R
venue: Journal of Statistical Software
one_line_finding: Continuous-time Markov multi-state models for irregularly observed panel data, with covariate effects on transition intensities.

title: Learning phrase representations using RNN encoder-decoder for statistical machine translation
venue: Proceedings of the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP)
one_line_finding: Introduces the gated recurrent unit within an RNN encoder-decoder for sequence modelling.

title: Attention is all you need
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
one_line_finding: Transformer architecture built solely on multi-head self-attention, replacing recurrence for sequence transduction.

title: FiLM: Visual reasoning with a general conditioning layer
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_line_finding: Feature-wise affine modulation conditioned on an auxiliary input provides a general, cheap conditioning mechanism.

title: Strictly proper scoring rules, prediction, and estimation
venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
one_line_finding: Characterises proper scoring rules including CRPS and quantile (pinball) scores for probabilistic forecast evaluation.

title: A simple sequentially rejective multiple test procedure
venue: Scandinavian Journal of Statistics
one_line_finding: Step-down Bonferroni procedure controlling family-wise error rate with more power than plain Bonferroni.

title: Individual comparisons by ranking methods
venue: Biometrics Bulletin
one_line_finding: Introduces the rank-sum and signed-rank tests for paired and two-sample comparisons without normality assumptions.

title: Statistical comparisons of classifiers over multiple data sets
venue: Journal of Machine Learning Research
one_line_finding: Recommends Wilcoxon signed-rank and Friedman tests with post-hoc procedures for comparing classifiers across datasets.

title: Bootstrap methods: Another look at the jackknife
venue: The Annals of Statistics
one_line_finding: Introduces the bootstrap, resampling the observed data to approximate sampling distributions and confidence intervals.

title: Adam: A method for stochastic optimization
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: Adaptive first- and second-moment estimates of gradients give an efficient, robust stochastic optimiser.

title: Long-tail learning via logit adjustment
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_line_finding: Adjusting logits by log class priors, post hoc or in the loss, yields Fisher-consistent balanced-error minimisation for imbalanced labels.
